items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: we had a couple of fellas from New Orleans that was on the show, but they had left us about a week before that. One was Joe Snayee.

ctx.x: Well, I think of it, who else was in the band in that show? Can you think of anybody else that, anybody else from New Orleans or anyone? Yeah. Well, no,
we had a couple of fellas from New Orleans that was on the show, but they had left us about a week before that. One was Joe Snayee. He's dead now. He was trumpet player.
He was in San Francisco, I guess. Yeah. Before he died.
